scope: Inventory of all 124 guides; new source-linked improvements to 20 existing guides, following the previous four-guide pass. This report does not certify that every factual claim on the site has been freshly verified.
selection: Measured impressions for Doi Suthep, Dadaocheng, Penang heritage queries, Tokyo listening and Design Week; other pages chosen for current visitor decisions, dated-notice risk and official-source gaps. No new keyword volumes or rankings are inferred.
